cycle.title: OneTravel Academy Challenge — constrained scout
cycle.overview: Imported from supplied overview. Search flights/hotels/cars and booking flow before final purchase. Current full test-case definitions have not been imported; this configuration cannot claim complete test-case coverage.
inScope: Filters, sorting, valid itinerary changes, state and price consistency
Booking flow before purchase; local version when available
outOfScope: Orders, payments or adding payment methods
sources: MASTER_BUG_LIBRARY.md and BUG_LESSONS.md are heuristics, not duplicate evidence
evidence: Console TXT/LOG with timestamps and Navigated to homepage
Cycle requires issue reproduced more than twice before submission
